CollaborationSessionRecord.title: CollaborationSessionRecord
CollaborationSessionRecord.description: Published session record: immutable content plus its content address.

CollaborationSession.title: CollaborationSession
CollaborationSession.description: Immutable collaboration session record: tenant-scoped, optionally workspace/project-narrowed, opened by a principal at a producer-supplied instant.

CollaborationRecordVersion.title: CollaborationRecordVersion
CollaborationRecordVersion.description: Version discriminator carried by every serialized collaboration record (currently 1).

CollaborationSessionId.title: CollaborationSessionId
CollaborationSessionId.description: Opaque collaboration session identity: "session:" followed by a lowercase slug.

CollaborationTenantId.title: CollaborationTenantId
CollaborationTenantId.description: Opaque tenant scope of a collaboration session (W009 grammar).

SessionScope.title: SessionScope
SessionScope.description: Optional tenant-hierarchy narrowing of a session: workspace and (with it) project ids.

ParticipantPrincipalId.title: ParticipantPrincipalId
ParticipantPrincipalId.description: Opaque session participant principal id (W009 grammar).

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).
